text: Saint Pierre and Miquelon, officially the Territorial Collectivity of Saint-Pierre and Miquelon, is an overseas department and region of France, south of Newfoundland in Canada. As such, for country streaks purposes, it is **counted as France**.
text_zh: 聖皮耶與密克隆（官方名稱為聖皮耶與密克隆海外集體）是法國的海外屬地與大區，位於加拿大紐芬蘭島南方。因此，出於國家連勝（country streaks）的考量，它**被算作法國**。

text: Licence plates can be either white or yellow and either short or long. They all have a blue EU strip however, and the white plates will also have a blue strip on the right, as is custom in France. Vehicles may or may not have front plates.
text_zh: 車牌可以是白色或黃色，也可以是短牌或長牌。然而，它們都有藍色歐盟標條，且白牌右側也會帶有藍色標條，這是法國的慣例。車輛可能裝有或未裝前車牌。

text: All coverage was taken with a **Generation 3 trekker camera**.
text_zh: 所有街景覆蓋都是用 **Generation 3 徒步拍攝相機**拍攝的。

text: Most houses are made of wooden panels with a **boxy look** and often **vivid colours**.
text_zh: 多數房屋由木板建造，具有**方正的外觀**且通常色彩**鮮豔**。

text: The landscape mainly consists of flat or rolling **grasslands**. The coast will be visible more often than not.
text_zh: 地貌主要由平坦或起伏的**草原**組成。通常海岸隨時可見。

text: Coverage is fairly limited, being only found in the eastern parts of Saint-Pierre as well as at the northern tip of Miquelon-Langlade.
text_zh: 街景覆蓋相當有限，僅能在聖皮耶東部以及密克隆朗格拉德的最北端找到。

text: Miquelon-Langlade is a small town in the north of St Pierre. It can be recognized by the houses with timber cladding painted in **bold, vivid colours**. [A shadow of the ATV](https://goo.gl/maps/QKtCCJyEA33ukUTw9) used to cover this town can also be seen.
text_zh: 米克隆-朗克拉德（Miquelon-Langlade）是聖皮埃爾（St Pierre）北部的一個小鎮。可以透過漆上**大膽鮮豔色彩**、帶有木質外牆的房屋來辨識。也可以看到用來拍攝這個小鎮的[全地形車（ATV）影子](https://goo.gl/maps/QKtCCJyEA33ukUTw9)。

text: Saint-Pierre is the capital and largest town. The coverage in this town is made with a **sidewalk trekker**. Larger buildings and more cars can be seen, with a more populated feel compared to Miquelon-Langlade.
text_zh: 聖皮耶是首都與最大城鎮。此城鎮的街景覆蓋是使用**人行道徒步拍攝**拍攝的。相較於密克隆與朗格德，這裡可以看到較大的建築物和較多車輛，給人更熱鬧的感覺。

text: A slightly **hilly, grass**y landscape with boxy houses spaced apart can be seen on Île-aux-Marins.
text_zh: 在聖保祿島（Île-aux-Marins）上可以看到稍微**起伏、長滿草**的景觀，並有著間距較遠的方正房屋。

text: This rural trekker in the far north can be recognized by the **rolling, grassy** landscape. The trekker can also be seen walking on a wooden path, with trees on either side.
text_zh: 這個位於極北處的鄉村徒步拍攝可以透過**起伏、長滿草**的景觀來辨識。也可以看到徒步拍攝走在木棧道上，兩側都有樹木。

text: The rural trekker on Saint Pierre island has a more **rocky** landscape. The trekker also walks on a path with trees on both sides.
text_zh: 聖皮耶島上的鄉村徒步拍攝具有較多**岩石**的景觀。徒步拍攝也走在兩側有樹木的小徑上。

text: This **boat** **trekker** between Saint Pierre Island and Île-aux-Marins can be recognized by this man wearing a grey and black sweater.
text_zh: 這個位於聖皮耶島與聖保祿島之間的**船隻** **徒步拍攝**可以透過這名穿著灰黑色毛衣的男子來辨識。
